column1: # Reviewed CodeQL alerts that scripts/codeql-local.sh lets through.
# rule<TAB>path prefix<TAB>text in the alert message<TAB>why it is safe
# An alert passes only when all three match. Keep entries narrow, and give each
# one a reason a reviewer can check. Everything else fails the gate.

column4: The CLI runs as the user; HOME and REMEMBER_* name the user's own files.
The "input" is random_hex's /dev/urandom bytes, hex-encoded into a temp-file suffix (fileio.c).
The harness runs the binary under test, named on its own command line.
The sqlite3 fixture runs test SQL on a test path, both shell-quoted by shell_quote_append.
Test files live under make_temp_db_path()'s mkdtemp directory (0700).
